rationale: The primary blocker is tester_bug: test_vectors.h has syntax errors (excess commas in scalar initializers lines 11-20) preventing compilation and execution of any functional tests. This is a clear testbench defect unrelated to specification or implementation correctness. While analyzer correctly identified expert_implementation_bug for SR2 (early return/break statements) and SR4 (ternary operator), these security violations cannot be verified dynamically until tests compile. The infrastructure_issue (missing bambu) is secondary since static security checks already detected the implementation flaws. Classification: tester_bug takes precedence because it blocks all verification. Retain_task=false because security requirements SR2 and SR4 fail on static analysis, and we cannot waive security requirements even if functional tests were passing. Once test syntax is fixed and functional tests pass, the expert implementation must be revised to remove forbidden control flow patterns before task can be retained.
revision_instructions: Fix test_vectors.h syntax errors on lines 11-20: remove all double commas before array elements in initializer lists. Each test vector struct should have format {input_token_array, reference_token_array, expected_result, test_name} with single commas separating fields. Verify array initializers use proper brace syntax for nested arrays. After syntax fix, re-run csim to validate functional requirements FR1-FR4 can execute. The expert implementation has security violations (SR2 early return/break, SR4 ternary operator) that must be addressed separately, but those cannot be verified until test compilation succeeds.
